display_long_description:
The Rhythm of the Reach
Forget everything you know about standard "WASD" movement. Sol Apes is a minimalist sandbox (Will be implemented soon) designed around a singular, high-fidelity experience: The Ultimate Bounce. While other games clutter your screen with objectives and combat, we’ve dedicated every line of code to the sensation of momentum. Featuring a ground-up rebuild of traditional physics, our updated locomotion system transforms the environment into a reactive playground.

Key Features:

Tactile Locomotion: Feel the weight, tension, and spring-loaded energy of a movement engine that prioritizes "juice" over everything else.

The "Flow" State: Experience a seamless transition between jumps, rebounds, and glides that rewards timing and intuition.

Minimalist Immersion: With no menus to clutter your view and no enemies to distract your focus, the world exists solely to be interacted with through your movement.

Reactive Environments: Every surface is tuned to respond to your velocity, creating a satisfying, rubberized feedback loop that makes "just moving around" more addictive than a high-score chase.

It isn't about where you’re going; it’s about how it feels to get there. Stop playing the game—start feeling the bounce.
